en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Fazzal, from Yunus Bin Yaqoub, from Abu Maryan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> judged that there would be no burden upon the (wergild payable by) the blood relatives except for the bone exposing injury upwards’.
And he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘What is below bone reaching injury, the fees of the doctor is in addition to the wergild’.
